notes.drawing: Direction A, from above like Phosphor's bug-beetle and butterfly: an upright body (ellipse 76 by 124) with two stripes, a round head with two antennae, and a wing on each side, tilted 28 degrees. The body is drawn over the wings and the bottom of the head.
notes.fill: Body and head solid, the two stripes cut as white lines that stop 8 units inside the edge, so they do not cut into the wings where these meet the body. The wings stay lines, as the second object stays a line in cards-fill: solid wings either merged into the body or, cut apart from it, turned into two small fins.
notes.bold: The head is 2 units bigger (radius 22) and 4 units higher, so its opening stays open above the body at 24.
